entities.name: Zaraya
entities.description: Commander of the Knights of Kjeldor during the Ice Age, a celebrated knight who knew the spell Winds of Kataba.

entities.name: Balo Kailo
entities.description: Lord and former lover of Zaraya.

entities.name: Severin
entities.description: Son of Zaraya and Balo Kailo, killed on a mission.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Necromancer whose undead minions were fought off.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Received the Nova Pentacle from Zaraya; cast the World Spell.

entities.name: Nova Pentacle
entities.description: Given to Freyalise, later used by Jaeuhl Carthalion.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: Spell cast by Freyalise in which Zaraya participated.

events.summary: Zaraya and Balo Kailo split after their son Severin is killed on a mission under her command.
events.quote: they split up after their son Severin was killed in a mission under her command

events.summary: Zaraya leads a band of six to aid the Marked Ones of Balduvia and fights off Lim-Dûl's undead minions.
events.quote: Together they managed to fight off Lim-Dûl 's undead minions.

events.summary: Zaraya gives the Nova Pentacle to Freyalise and takes part in the World Spell.
events.quote: Zaraya gave the Nova Pentacle to Freyalise

relations.quote: was the commander of the Knights of Kjeldor
She was once the lover of Lord Balo Kailo
